programme.desc: When Amanda is partnered up with Sam at work, she has no idea that he is the man she has been flirting with in a chatroom. Can their fiery online chemistry hold up in real life.

programme.title: To All A Good Night
programme.desc: When a small-town photographer saves the life of a mysterious man who is in town to buy her family's parkland, she may have inadvertently saved Christmas with him.

programme.title: The Way To You
programme.desc: New Yorkers Emma and Conrad agree to help each other find their missed connections after a subway blackout. Their search leads to a place neither of them expects.

programme.title: Journey To You
programme.desc: After missing out on a promotion, Monica walks the Camino de Santiago. She's surprised when she finds inner peace and a potential romance.

programme.title: A Make Or Break Holiday
programme.desc: A couple hosting Christmas decides to fake their relationship after choosing to separate. Working together for the holiday helps them remember why they fell in love.

programme.title: Love & Jane
programme.desc: Lilly, a hopeless romantic and literary enthusiast, is surprised when her wish to talk to her favourite author comes true and Jane Austen herself appears in her life.

programme.title: The Love Heist
programme.desc: When a fashion treasure goes missing before the Chicago Costume Gala, celebrity stylist Kayli teams up with security chief Mills to track it down.

programme.title: A Scottish Love Scheme
programme.desc: Lily travels to Scotland and meets Logan, a childhood family friend, where their mothers are hatching a plan to get them together, once and for all. Steamy romance.

programme.title: Savoring Paris
programme.desc: After growing bored with her life, Ella embarks on a soul-searching journey to Paris, navigating romance, self-discovery and cheese amid the city of love's enchanting backdrop.

programme.title: Three Wiser Men And A Boy
programme.desc: The Brenner brothers are back and putting on a holiday pageant for young Thomas, while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mum's new boyfriend.

programme.title: The Marry Me Pact
programme.desc: When a psychic tells Charlotte she is destined to marry her best friend, Rory, only one thing stands in her way... his fiancée.

programme.title: Paging Mr. Darcy
programme.desc: A mutual love of Jane Austen's stories causes an overly serious scholar and an actor playing Mr Darcy to fall head over heels into their own fairy tale romance.

programme.title: Romance At Hope Ranch
programme.desc: Hope Morgan arrives in Ruidoso, New Mexico, to fulfil her childhood dream of running a ranch and revive the beloved Giddy Up Gala. Starring Alison Sweeney and Gabriel Hogan.

programme.title: An American In Austen
programme.desc: Having given up on searching for the man of her dreams, Harriet is transported into the world of Pride and Prejudice to find one. No man can compare to Mr Darcy - can they.

programme.title: Three Wisest Men
programme.desc: The Brenner brothers are back and putting on a holiday pageant for young Thomas, while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mum's new boyfriend.

programme.title: Married By Mistake
programme.desc: After losing her job, exec Riley gets drunk in Las Vegas and wakes up married. Things get even more complex when she meets her new husband's brother.

programme.title: An Alpine Holiday
programme.desc: Estranged sisters Faith and Kelly reunite to fulfil their grandmother's last wish as they travel to the French Alps for Christmas, bonding and finding love along the way.

programme.title: My Norwegian Holiday
programme.desc: Grieving the loss of her grandmother, JJ heads to an unexpected holiday destination and meets the charming Henrik. Holiday romance.

programme.title: 12 Dares Of Christmas
programme.desc: Teacher Elara's quiet holiday season gets a jolt of spice when she accepts a 12 Dares of Christmas challenge from her sister.

programme.title: An Ice Palace Romance
programme.desc: After a journalist returns to her hometown ice rink to cover a story, the rink's owner melts her heart.

programme.title: A Biltmore Christmas
programme.desc: A magical hourglass sends modern-day screenwriter Lucy Hardgrove back in time to 1946.

programme.title: A Carol For Two
programme.desc: When talented singer Violette takes a job as a waitress in New York, things get complicated when her duet partner sets her up with a friend but starts developing feelings himself.

programme.title: Everything Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas enthusiast Lori-Jo embarks on an epic three-day road trip with her workaholic best friend to the town where it's Christmas all year round.

programme.title: Trivia At St Nick's
programme.desc: At a local bar's trivia tournament at the end of the semester, two mismatched students team up to win the coveted prize - and fall in love along the way.

programme.title: Trading Up Christmas
programme.desc: Keri desperately needs a new home and her sister Michelle hatches a plan to help. With only a Christmas stocking, she sets out to trade her way up to something far greater-a house.

programme.title: The Snow Must Go On
programme.desc: A teacher takes his students to a breathtaking glacier. However, soon the students realise the impact of global warming and strive to protect the glacier from disappearing.

programme.title: Unforgettable Christmas
programme.desc: When Princess Colette works with designer Wilson James on the collection for a Christmas Eve charity gala, she finds both her true calling and her true love.
